quote: The Spire on Michigan Avenue casts a shadow that doesn't match its shape. At noon, when the shadow should be shortest, it stretches three blocks east and covers a park that isn't on any map. People picnic there. They bring their children.
context: Shadow anomalies are common enough in the GLMZ that they have become features rather than disturbances. The unmapped park has its own community, its own regulars, its own sense of permanence.
